finalists.label: Atypical Femoral Fracture
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck.

finalists.label: Osteonecrosis
finalists.why: It has relevant findings, including denosumab for osteoporosis and an incomplete transverse fracture, but lacks specificity compared to Atypical Femoral Fracture.

finalists.label: Osteonecrosis of the Femoral Head
finalists.why: It has some relevant findings, such as difficulty walking and low bone mineral density, but is contradicted by the location of the fracture and imaging findings.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it specifically accounts for the incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck, which is a distinctive feature of atypical femoral fractures.
